profile.name: Xiaohang Yang
profile.department: Beijing International Center for Mathematical Research

about: I am a Ph.D. student in mathematics at Peking University, based at the Beijing International Center for Mathematical Research (BICMR).
My mathematical interests lie in representation theory and automorphic forms, with a particular interest in the Langlands program.
home.notes_intro: This space is for expository notes, seminar handouts, and talks related to my mathematical interests.

research.intro: I am interested in the representation theory of reductive groups and its connections with automorphic forms and the Langlands program.

topics.title: Representation theory
topics.summary: Reductive groups over local fields and the representation theory of p-adic groups.

topics.title: Automorphic forms
topics.summary: The trace formula, endoscopy, and the interplay between local and global questions.

topics.title: The Langlands program
topics.summary: Connections between representations, arithmetic, and geometry.
